evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep said 'it might take ten to fifteen minutes of your time. Is that okay?' but never explicitly said 'you can walk away with a quote you can depend on' or waited decisively for confirmation before pivoting to logistics.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Name (Kendall), date (first or second), route (storage unit to house address), size (two units, 10x5 and 10x15 combined to 20 sq ft) — all four covered.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Not asked. Rep moved straight into logistics probing ('Would you say that both of the storage units are completely full?') without asking 'What are your biggest concerns about this move?'
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (indoor storage unit to 1-story house), floors/stories (storage on 2nd and 3rd, house 1-story), rooms/items (hutch, two couches, desk, daybed, shelf, bookcases, coffee tables, bed frame, mattress, dressers), walking distance (elevator with dollies, <10 feet, <200 feet estimates), special considerations (heavy hutch separable, prior move took 2h 15min with 3 movers), additional stops (none beyond drop-off). Full coverage.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Not offered. No mention of 'Would you like us to pack your items into boxes for you?'
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Yes — 'Do you have an estimated number of boxes inside?' Customer said 30, rep confirmed combined count.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Full — rep provided typical ranges (5x10 in 2.5 hours, 10x15 in 6-7 hours) and personalized to this move (8-9 hours with 2 movers, then revised to 5-6 hours with 3 movers). Total $1,650–$1,980 with 3 movers. Anchored and specific.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Full — $110/hour per mover, $220 for two (later three), 2.5-hour minimum, time prorated in 15-minute increments. Disclosure: 'Everything is included to that gas and truck taxes, insurance. All the wraps and pads' and 'no heat and fees of any type. No credit card fees, no terrible fees, no disassemble or reassemble fee, no transportation fees.'
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked — rep never asked 'Does that feel fair?' or equivalent; moved directly to booking discussion after the estimate.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: None — no mention of On-Time Guarantee or discount terms for lateness.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: None — no mention of No Worries Damage Coverage, $2,000 coverage, deductible structure, or coverage built into the rate.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: False — no 'Does that put those to rest?' or similar closing of the Two Promises section.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Throwaway — rep asked 'Any questions for, let you know' (malformed) and accepted immediate 'Nope' with no follow-up. Not a genuine 'What's still concerning you about this move?' question.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not asked — no version of 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' was delivered.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never — rep never asked 'Would you like our help with your move?' Instead, customer asked 'why don't you put me on the schedule?' and rep booked without an explicit forward ask.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Yes — 'No deposit is required ma'am. I just need your verbal confirmation that you want to be on the schedule' and later 'even a day before we can still cancel your move.' No-deposit and cancellation flexibility stated.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Full — Date (Friday October 2nd), time (8:30–9:00 AM), addresses (storage unit at 1000 East Fiftieth Street and drop-off at 1419 Richmond Drive), crew size (3 movers), confirmation email to follow. All confirmed.

top_strength: Excellent discovery and logistics probing — rep gathered detailed information about storage unit configuration, furniture, distances, elevator access, and prior move experience, which informed a personalized and revised estimate upward to 3 movers for a better customer outcome.
coaching_note: Two Promises section (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) was completely skipped, and Section 6's final concerns check was perfunctory ('Any questions?') instead of genuine; add both to close coverage gaps and give customers confidence in Einstein's commitments before booking.
